## Checklist

- [ ] The state file says where we are and what comes next
- [ ] The history file has an entry (what, branch, verified result), where the repo has one
- [ ] Any decision is recorded as an ADR
- [ ] Assessment status rows updated, if this PR does or rejects an item
- [ ] No secrets, state files, plans or `.env` files in the diff
- [ ] Actions minutes estimated (0 when only Markdown changes)
